meta.name: abp-dependency-rules
meta.description: ABP Framework v10.x (10.4/10.5) layer dependency rules: layer direction (Domain.Shared→Domain→Application.Contracts→Application→HttpApi→Host), project reference matrix, anti-patterns (no DbContext in Application, don't expose IQueryable, don't return entity as DTO). Use when you need project/layer architecture or dependency rules in ABP.

howto.what: 安装此技能后，Claude 会依据 ABP Framework v10.x 的官方规范，回答关于项目层依赖方向、引用矩阵和反模式的问题。它不会允许在 Application 层使用 DbContext、暴露 IQueryable 或返回实体作为 DTO。
howto.when: 当你询问 ABP 项目层架构或依赖规则时触发。例如：提出“ABP layer architecture”、“ABP dependency rules”或“ABP 层架构”等关键词。

say.text: ABP 的应用层能引用基础设施层吗？
say.note: Claude 会解释层依赖方向并指出错误做法。

say.text: 在 ABP 中，DbContext 应该放在哪一层？
ABP 多应用场景下 Admin 和 Public 如何共享领域层？

howto.what_en: With this skill, Claude follows ABP Framework v10.x official best practices to answer questions about project layer dependency direction, reference matrix, and anti-patterns. It rejects using DbContext in Application, exposing IQueryable, or returning entities as DTOs.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask about ABP project layer architecture or dependency rules, e.g., using keywords like "ABP layer architecture", "ABP dependency rules", or "ABP layer dependency".

say_en.text: Can the Application layer reference Infrastructure?
say_en.note: Claude explains the dependency direction and flags violations.

say_en.text: Where should DbContext be placed in ABP?
say_en.note: Claude clarifies DbContext goes only in the data layer via repository interface.

say_en.text: How do Admin and Public share the domain in multi-app scenarios?
say_en.note: Claude shows separate application layers with shared Domain project.
